purpose: Test hardened local Evidence Packet v0 on Watermelon and LaunchDarkly snapshots to check whether it distinguishes ambiguity from clean evidence without blocking everything.

watermelon_assessment.remaining_risk: Local v0 cannot prove explicit relationships for some likely related surfaces without stronger upstream link extraction.

launchdarkly_assessment.remaining_risk: Some eligible external sources may still need source-role weighting, and empty-text URL evidence should be downgraded or enriched before generation.

overall_verdict: The hardened packet is not simply blocking everything. It blocks Builtwith, constrains Watermelon, and preserves substantial LaunchDarkly evidence.
not_ready_for_generation_reasons: empty-text URL evidence can still be eligible
external comparison and release aggregator sources need source-role weighting
social profile candidates need verification status
explicit links from audited pages should be extracted before relation confidence is upgraded
full nested dimension contract is not yet emitted
recommended_next_step: Run a narrow hardening pass for empty-text URL evidence, source role subtypes, social verification status, and explicit-link extraction; then rerun Watermelon and LaunchDarkly before any lab prompt test.
non_goals_preserved: no Exa Firecrawl or API calls
